business: BFL is a deposit-taking NBFC-ICC offering diversified lending to retail, MSME, and commercial customers across urban and rural India through 4,098 locations. Revenue from interest income on loans, deposits, service fees, and payments.

segments.name: Consumer Lending
segments.comment: Electronics, furniture, two/three-wheelers; ₹115,161 crore disbursed FY2026

segments.name: Personal Loans
segments.comment: Unsecured lending with EMI card enablement; ₹21,500 crore digital

segments.name: MSME Lending
segments.comment: Secured and unsecured lending to micro, small, medium enterprises

segments.name: Wheels Financing
segments.comment: Auto and two-wheeler financing; dealer network 10,000+

segments.name: Gold Loans
segments.comment: Secured lending against gold; 1,314 branches; ₹17,831 crore AUM

segments.name: Mortgages
segments.comment: Housing finance; ₹1,300 crore digital disbursals; SBU established

segments.name: Payments
segments.comment: UPI, wallet, FASTag, bill pay; 129.29 crore transactions

segments.name: Deposits
segments.comment: Public and corporate deposits; ₹497 crore digital mobilized

revenue_mix: Digital contributed 16.32% of business. 4,098 locations span urban-rural (2,571 rural). Retail, MSME, commercial customer segments. Secured and unsecured lending diversified.
strategy: Customer-centric transformation using design thinking and propensity-led engagement
AI and data leadership: unstructured data, feature stores, vector databases, knowledge graphs
Lowest-risk positioning via AI-enabled fraud, compliance, risk, operations controls
Omnichannel expansion: 87M app users, 611M web visits, 4,098 locations
Product innovation: wealth management, solar financing, corporate leasing, NCMC distribution
outlook: FY2030 targets: 200-220M customers, 19-21% ROE, 12-15% AI productivity gains, 50% operations cost reduction by FY2030. Strong FY2027 momentum. Management optimistic.
capex_plans: Expand locations to 4,600-4,900 by FY2030. Gold branches scaled 964 to 1,314. Significant AI, data infrastructure and digital platform investments. Specific amounts not disclosed.
risks: Geopolitical escalation (Middle East, Iran) impacting commodity prices and trade flows
US-China trade tensions, tariffs, semiconductor export control on strategic sectors
Global economic slowdown from elevated policy uncertainty and fragmentation
Commodity price volatility and supply chain disruptions
flags: Material RPT with BHFL: ₹18,152 crore limit. BFL shareholding reduced 88.75% to 86.70%; ₹1,416 crore gain realized. Accelerated ECL provision ₹1,406 crore; LGD floor implemented.
